scope: Focused independent retest using fresh stdio and attached native MCP checks.

initialQALiveEvaluations.note: The initial count is retained separately; no combined correctness claim is made across the two runs.

behaviorObserved.singleAvailableChoice: preview accepted; live classification recommended the available choice
behaviorObserved.unavailableOnlyChoices: abstained or skipped with an insufficient-available-candidates disposition; no provider transport for the unavailable-only classifier case
behaviorObserved.mixedTypedBatch: Choice passed, Noul returned 0.99 in the tested direction, and Score selected level 2 from three explicit ordinal levels
behaviorObserved.outcomeValidation: callerReported false and a mismatched provider identifier were rejected; a legitimate linked outcome was read back with callerReported true and independentlyVerified false

limitations: This is focused QA evidence, not exhaustive release acceptance or a model-quality benchmark.
Latency and token observations are run estimates rather than billing measurements.
Incidental automatic-hook authentication failures were observed early in the turn; later explicit native and fresh-process checks succeeded, and the cause was not investigated.
The evidence does not establish hosted CI, provider billing reconciliation, production deployment, global automation reconfiguration, or official directory approval.
